notes.title: Nadrazur camp
notes.notes:
[b]Hello adventurers![/b]

Here are a few screenshots of Nadrazur camp, the first settlement you will meet outside the starter zone. Nadrazur is the home of clashing elementals, currently overwhelmed by rocky creatures. 

[b]The settlement[/b]

Here you will find the first connected flight point, allowing you the travel back to Eimville. When you are tired of questing, you can meet your fellow players in the Inn or learn your first crafting skills. Make sure you have gathered enough materials, when you get here...
